WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, member_key,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS nver
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT
  count(*) AS first_versions,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
  sum(CASE WHEN valid_from <> join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vf_ne_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_store,
  min(join_date), max(join_date),
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_fy2526
FROM fv WHERE vn = 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member),
nw AS (SELECT * FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'),
st AS (SELECT store_id, max(store_name) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS store_name, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT store_name) AS names, max(close_date) AS close_date, max(region) FILTER (WHERE is_current) AS region FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT nw.home_store_id, st.store_name, st.region, st.versions, st.names, st.close_date, count(*) AS new_members
FROM nw LEFT JOIN st ON st.store_id = nw.home_store_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member),
nw AS (SELECT * FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'),
st AS (SELECT store_id, min(open_date) AS open_date, max(close_date) AS close_date FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT nw.home_store_id, st.open_date, st.close_date, count(*) AS n,
  min(join_date) AS first_join, max(join_date) AS last_join,
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date < st.open_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_open,
  sum(CASE WHEN join_date > st.close_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS after_close
FROM nw JOIN st ON st.store_id = nw.home_store_id
WHERE st.open_date IS NOT NULL OR st.close_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL

WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT fv.home_store_id AS store_id, cs.store_name, COUNT(*) AS new_members
FROM first_version fv
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fv.join_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = fv.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fv.version_no = 1
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
